Before you trust a password manager: client-side encryption, recent third-party audits, passkeys and hardware keys. Both AI models pick 1Password, but not the same plan. https://1billionmodels.com/software/business-and-office/password-management?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=short&utm_campaign=answer

title: Three checks before you trust a password manager
